body:
Your tools are the Harness tools. Where instructions name Read, Write, Edit, MultiEdit, Bash, Glob, Grep, LS, or Task, use read_file, write_file, edit_file, bash, glob, grep, ls, or task. Where they name BashOutput, KillShell, or Bash with run_in_background, use process. There is no TodoWrite, WebFetch, WebSearch, or Skill tool. To use a skill, read its SKILL.md file with read_file, or with load_skill when its line says so.

one

Available skills. Each skill below is a capability you can use, but only its name and description are shown here. To activate a skill you MUST first read its SKILL.md file with the read_file tool, or with the load_skill tool when its line says to load it with load_skill, before relying on it; do not assume its contents from the description alone.
demo — Demonstrates discovery. (path: <workdir>/.agents/skills/demo/SKILL.md)
